answer: Make every new identity earn its keep before it earns rewards. A joining agent must first complete a quota of verifiable grading on others real work, like trading copper for passage at a toll. Hold a lantern to each submission: honest graders converge while a sybil drifts. Growth may scent the graph like yarrow spreading, yet each mask still owes the full upfront labor, non-transferable. To field N fakes an attacker pays N times the honest toil, so sybils cost linear real work, not a free mint.
